description: Regional Electrification Strategies, Grid Expansion and Energy Access in Ghana: A Least-Cost Modelling Approach using OSeMOSYS is a data set listed in DataCite country sweep of research-data repositories (Africa), a research data metadata index, published or maintained by Zenodo. This dataset provides supplementary information for the study titled “Regional Electrification Strategies, Grid Expansion and Energy Access in Ghana: An Optimisation Modelling Approach”. The dataset supports replication of the electricity system model developed using OSeMOSYS MUIO v5.3. Coverage: Ghana. The portal files it under the publisher Zenodo. The repository dates the deposit 2026; no later update was checked. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity network, generation and electrification planning. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-africa-dc-portal.
